# Evgeny Shtein

> Personal portfolio site for Evgeny Shtein, VP Engineering / Head of Engineering in cybersecurity and AI-driven platforms.

## Summary

Evgeny Shtein is a hands-on engineering leader with 15+ years of experience across cybersecurity, endpoint security, SaaS platforms, DevOps, FinOps, cloud infrastructure, Android framework, embedded systems, and engineering culture.

He leads large international engineering teams and focuses on strong execution, healthy work culture, supportive working environments, balanced work-life expectations, infrastructure improvement, and cost discipline.
